exposure: stage of labor at time of cesarean delivery in previous pregnancy
cohort: 180 females with a singleton pregnancy and a prior cesarean delivery.
finding: There was a significant association between cesarean delivery in the second stage of labor and subsequent preterm birth in females presenting with a singleton pregnancy.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor was associated with a higher risk of subsequent preterm birth.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery in the index pregnancy was 39.04+/-1.94 weeks for group I (C-section at first stage) and 38.22+/-3.05 weeks for group II (C-section at second stage).
followup_time: Until delivery of the index pregnancy.
